maddeler.e:
استثنيا (form X)
# اِسْتَثْنَيَا (istaṯnayā) /is.taθ.na.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اُسْتُثْنِيَا (ustuṯniyā) /us.tuθ.ni.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اِسْتَثْنِيَا (istaṯniyā) /is.taθ.ni.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
